item.tib: spos ri ngad ldan gyi bsang mchod nyung 'dus
item.coloph: ces pa'i gnas chen rdo rje rdzong chen spos ri ngad ldan gyi bsang mchod 'di ni mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang / shar phyogs dngos slob bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal/ sangs rgyas dang / mgon po dbang rgyal/ skal bzang rgyal mtshan/ bzod pha (pa) phur pa/ rdo rje phun tshogs sogs kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas bris pas yul 'dir bde legs 'byung bar gyur cig/
